title: MyLinden Terms for Virtual Care Follow-Up Messages and After-Visit Summaries
content:
Two after-visit figures apply to each Virtual Care visit type: the number of calendar days after the encounter during which follow-up portal messages are included at no charge, and the number of hours after completion within which the after-visit summary is posted.

## Definitions

- **Included follow-up messages** — calendar days after the encounter during which follow-up portal messages about the encounter are included at no charge.
- **After-visit summary** — hours after completion within which the after-visit summary is posted.

## Figures by visit type

| Visit type | Included follow-up messages | After-visit summary posted within |
|---|---|---|
| Portal E-Visit | 7 calendar days | 24 hours |
| Audio-Only Phone Visit | 3 calendar days | 24 hours |
| Primary Care Video Visit | 7 calendar days | 24 hours |
| Behavioral Health Video Visit | 14 calendar days | 48 hours |
| Specialty Video Follow-Up | 7 calendar days | 48 hours |
| On-Demand Virtual Urgent Care | 3 calendar days | 12 hours |

## Reading the figures

- The Behavioral Health Video Visit carries the longest follow-up period, 14 calendar days; the Audio-Only Phone Visit and On-Demand Virtual Urgent Care carry the shortest, 3 calendar days.
- On-Demand Virtual Urgent Care carries the shortest summary period, 12 hours. The Behavioral Health Video Visit and the Specialty Video Follow-Up carry 48 hours, which is two days; the other three visit types carry 24 hours, which is one day.
